omens.omen_en: Lock in the final details of your plan today.
omens.omen_zh: 今日宜为你的计划敲定最后的细节。
omens.detail_en: Ancient 'Raising the Beam' marks the structural completion. Modernly, it is the best time to finalize your project framework or core strategy.
omens.detail_zh: 古代‘上梁’标志着结构完工。现代语境下，这是敲定项目框架或核心策略的最佳时机。

omens.omen_en: Celebrate a major milestone with your team.
omens.omen_zh: 今日宜与团队一起庆祝阶段性成果。
omens.detail_en: This was a community celebration of progress. Acknowledging a milestone today boosts morale and solidifies future success.
omens.detail_zh: 这是一个庆祝进展的时刻。今日确认阶段性里程碑能提振士气，巩固未来的成功。

omens.omen_en: Sign up for that online course or tutorial.
omens.omen_zh: 立刻报名那个你观望已久的在线课程。
omens.detail_en: Anciently for apprenticeships; today, your brain is primed for absorbing high-level technical skills or new software.
omens.detail_zh: 古代指拜师学艺；今日你的大脑处于接收状态，适合攻克高难度技术或新软件。

omens.omen_en: Spend one hour practicing a difficult technique.
omens.omen_zh: 花一小时专注练习一项高难度技能。
omens.detail_en: Focused repetition today leads to mastery. Don't just watch; do the work to build muscle memory.
omens.detail_zh: 今日的专注练习能让你迅速精进。不要只是看，亲自动手才能建立肌肉记忆。

omens.omen_en: Invest in a high-quality item for your home.
omens.omen_zh: 为家里添置一件能提升幸福感的高质感好物。
omens.detail_en: Buying property is about long-term stability. Even a small quality investment today strengthens your sense of 'home'.
omens.detail_zh: 置产关乎长期稳定。今日即便是一份小的高质感投资，也能增强你的“归属感”。

omens.omen_en: Research long-term assets or investment funds.
omens.omen_zh: 调研长期资产或投资基金。
omens.detail_en: An auspicious day for committing to your future security. Look for stability over quick wins.
omens.detail_zh: 这是为未来安全感做承诺的吉日。寻找稳健的资产，而非短期快钱。

omens.omen_en: Dress for the job you want, not the one you have.
omens.omen_zh: 穿上那套让你最自信的衣服去面对挑战。
omens.detail_en: Ancient 'Tailoring' was about creating a social identity. Refresh your look to align with your next career move.
omens.detail_zh: 古代‘裁制’是为了确立社会身份。更新形象，让你的外在与职业野心相匹配。

omens.omen_en: Invest in a high-quality 'uniform' for work.
omens.omen_zh: 为职场表现投资一套高质感的‘战袍’。
omens.detail_en: Your outer armor affects your inner confidence. Today is lucky for selecting clothes that project power.
omens.detail_zh: 外在的甲胄影响内在的自信。今日宜选择那些能展现专业力量的服饰。

omens.omen_en: Upgrade your digital workflow or subscription.
omens.omen_zh: 升级你的数字化工作流或生产力软件订阅。
omens.detail_en: Ancient 'Vehicles' expanded human reach. Modernly, tools that speed up your work are your new 'transportation'.
omens.detail_zh: 古代车辆扩展了人类足迹。现代语境下，提升工作速度的工具就是你的‘交通工具’。

omens.omen_en: Plan a trip or a new route for your commute.
omens.omen_zh: 规划一次旅行或试着走一条新的通勤路线。
omens.detail_en: Movement is favored today. Changing your physical path can spark a necessary mental breakthrough.
omens.detail_zh: 今日宜动。改变物理路径可以激发必要的思维突破。

omens.omen_en: Review your subscriptions and cancel unused ones.
omens.omen_zh: 检查并取消那些不再使用的自动扣款订阅。
omens.detail_en: Ancient trade was about fair exchange. Stop the 'leak' of resources to ensure your value flows efficiently.
omens.detail_zh: 古代交易讲求公平互换。停止资源流失，确保你的价值能够高效流转。

omens.omen_en: Negotiate a better rate or a new contract.
omens.omen_zh: 谈判一个更好的费率或签署一份新合同。
omens.detail_en: Communication for mutual gain is highly auspicious today. Don't be afraid to ask for a fairer deal.
omens.detail_zh: 今日利于互利互惠的沟通。不要害怕提出更公平的交易条件。

omens.omen_en: Delete the apps that are cluttering your focus.
omens.omen_zh: 删掉那些分散你精力的手机应用，清空干扰。
omens.detail_en: Lumbering clears the forest for new growth. Remove digital distractions to let your main project thrive.
omens.detail_zh: 伐木是为新生长清空空间。移除数字化干扰，让你的核心项目得以蓬勃发展。

omens.omen_en: Prune your 'To-Do' list of non-essential tasks.
omens.omen_zh: 从待办清单中精简掉那些非必要的任务。
omens.detail_en: You cannot do everything. Cutting away the low-value tasks today empowers the high-value ones.
omens.detail_zh: 你无法完成所有事。今日砍掉低价值任务，是为了赋予高价值任务更多能量。

omens.omen_en: Reach out to an old colleague for a virtual coffee.
omens.omen_zh: 主动给老同事发个信息，约一场线上叙旧。
omens.detail_en: Socializing today isn't just for fun; it's for resource sharing. A simple talk could unlock a new opportunity.
omens.detail_zh: 今日的社交不只是消遣，而是资源共享。简单的交谈可能开启全新的机遇。

omens.omen_en: Collaborate on a creative idea with a friend.
omens.omen_zh: 与朋友一起为一个创意想法碰撞火花。
omens.detail_en: Collective intelligence is peaked. Two minds working together today will produce 10x the results.
omens.detail_zh: 群体智慧处于巅峰。今日两人合力将产生十倍于独自工作的成果。

omens.omen_en: Take ownership of a difficult task at work today.
omens.omen_zh: 今天主动承担一项难题，展现你的核心能力。
omens.detail_en: The beam supports the whole roof. Today, proving you can handle the weight increases your authority.
omens.detail_zh: 梁支撑着整个屋顶。今日证明你能承担重任，将提升你的权威感。

omens.omen_en: Strengthen the core architecture of your project.
omens.omen_zh: 加固你项目的基础架构或底层逻辑。
omens.detail_en: Before adding features, fix the foundation. Today is lucky for deep structural improvements.
omens.detail_zh: 在增加功能前，先修补基础。今日适合进行深层的架构优化。

omens.omen_en: Meal prep for the week or try a healthy recipe.
omens.omen_zh: 今天宜下厨，为自己准备一份营养均衡的餐食。
omens.detail_en: The 'Hearth' is the energy center of the home. Optimizing your nutrition today fuels your productivity for the week.
omens.detail_zh: ‘灶’是家庭的能量中心。今日优化营养摄入，能为你一周的生产力补足燃料。

omens.omen_en: Optimize your kitchen or dining environment.
omens.omen_zh: 优化你的厨房或用餐环境。
omens.detail_en: A clean energy source leads to a clean mind. Tidying your eating space brings clarity to your work.
omens.detail_zh: 能量来源清净，思想才会清明。理清用餐环境能让工作思路更清晰。

omens.omen_en: Create a dedicated 'deep work' space today.
omens.omen_zh: 今日宜设立一个专属的‘深度工作’区。
omens.detail_en: An Xiang is about establishing a sacred space. Setting a physical boundary today tells your brain it's time to perform.
omens.detail_zh: 古代安香是为了确立神圣空间。今日设定物理边界，能提醒大脑进入高效模式。

omens.omen_en: Start a 5-minute morning ritual or meditation.
omens.omen_zh: 开启一项5分钟的早晨仪式或冥想练习。
omens.detail_en: This activity invites peace and presence. Setting a new ritual today grounds your mental health.
omens.detail_zh: 此项活动关乎安宁与存在感。今日建立新仪式感，能稳固你的心理健康。

omens.omen_en: Apply for that 'reach' job or send a cold pitch.
omens.omen_zh: 主动投递简历或向客户发送一份提案。
omens.detail_en: Ancient hunting was about skill and survival. Today, your 'predatory' instincts are sharp—go after a high-value target.
omens.detail_zh: 古代打猎关乎生存技能。今日你的竞争直觉敏锐，适合主动出击获取高价值机会。

omens.omen_en: Conduct a competitive analysis of your rivals.
omens.omen_zh: 对竞争对手进行一次深度分析。
omens.detail_en: Know your environment and your 'prey'. Use today to study the market gap and prepare your move.
omens.detail_zh: 了解环境与对手。今日宜研究市场空白，为下一步行动做准备。

omens.omen_en: Update your digital legacy or emergency contacts.
omens.omen_zh: 更新你的数字遗产设置或紧急联系人。
omens.detail_en: Respecting the past ensures a smooth future. Take a moment to organize the vital info your loved ones might need.
omens.detail_zh: 敬畏过去，方能安稳前行。花点时间整理那些至关重要的个人信息与备份。

omens.omen_en: Review a past project to fix its lingering issues.
omens.omen_zh: 回顾过去的项目并修复那些遗留的小问题。
omens.detail_en: Mending a grave is about honor and repair. Fixing old mistakes today prevents them from haunting your current work.
omens.detail_zh: 修葺坟茔意在缅怀与修复。今日修正旧错，能防止过去的失误干扰现有的进程。

omens.omen_en: Optimize your home office for better ergonomics.
omens.omen_zh: 优化居家办公的人体工学设置。
omens.detail_en: Small structural changes lead to big productivity gains. Adjust your monitor or chair to support your growth.
omens.detail_zh: 微小的结构调整能带来巨大的产能提升。调整桌椅高度，让环境支撑你的进步。

omens.omen_en: Start a renovation or a DIY repair project today.
omens.omen_zh: 今天宜开始一项修缮或DIY改造计划。
omens.detail_en: Physical maintenance mirrors mental maintenance. Improving your environment today brings fresh energy into your life.
omens.detail_zh: 物理环境的维护映射着心理状态。改善居住空间，能为生活注入全新的能量。

omens.omen_en: Archive an old folder and move it out of sight.
omens.omen_zh: 归档一个旧文件夹，将其移出视线范围。
omens.detail_en: Closure is necessary for peace. Formally 'burying' a finished project clears the mental space for what's next.
omens.detail_zh: 告别是获得安宁的必要途径。正式‘埋葬’已完成的项目，能为下个目标腾出心力。

omens.omen_en: Finalize a decision you have been avoiding.
omens.omen_zh: 为那个你一直在逃避的决定画上句号。
omens.detail_en: Accepting an ending is a powerful act of will. Today is lucky for finality and formal acceptance.
omens.detail_zh: 接纳终结是意志力的体现。今日利于尘埃落定，在心态上完成正式的交接。

omens.omen_en: Delete toxic contacts or leave draining group chats.
omens.omen_zh: 删除有毒的联系人，退出那些消耗你的群聊。
omens.detail_en: Removing the flame prevents the burn. Exit environments that stir up unnecessary heat and friction.
omens.detail_zh: 移走火源方能避免灼伤。今日宜退出那些引发无谓争端与内耗的环境。

omens.omen_en: Reset your router and clear your cache for a fresh start.
omens.omen_zh: 重启你的路由器并清除缓存，焕然一新。
omens.detail_en: Moving energy requires clearing the channels. A quick tech reset today mirrors the ancient clearing of a space.
omens.detail_zh: 能量的流动需要清空渠道。今日的小型设备重启，正合乎古代空间清扫之意。

omens.omen_en: Take a different route to work; inspiration awaits.
omens.omen_zh: 换一条通勤路线；灵感就在不经意间。
omens.detail_en: Changing your scenery changes your perspective. Today, a small detour could lead to a big breakthrough.
omens.detail_zh: 风景的改变会带来视角的转变。今日的小小绕路，可能会触发重大的思维突破。

omens.omen_en: Book a ticket or plan a trip for your future growth.
omens.omen_zh: 预定机票或为未来的成长规划一场旅行。
omens.detail_en: The universe favors movement today. Travel expands your horizons and brings back new solutions to old problems.
omens.detail_zh: 今日宇宙利于移动。远行能开阔眼界，并为老问题带回全新的解决方案。

omens.omen_en: Sell an unused item online to clear your space.
omens.omen_zh: 在网上卖掉一件闲置物品，清空你的空间。
omens.detail_en: Stagnant items block stagnant energy. Turning clutter into cash today is highly auspicious.
omens.detail_zh: 停滞的物品会阻塞能量。今日将闲置物转化为现金，是极佳的选择。

omens.omen_en: Make a purposeful purchase that aids your productivity.
omens.omen_zh: 进行一次有针对性的投资，提升你的生产力。
omens.detail_en: Money is energy meant to circulate. Spending on tools today creates a return on your investment quickly.
omens.detail_zh: 金钱是流动的能量。今日在专业工具上的投入，将很快为你带来回报。

omens.omen_en: Set a firm boundary with a co-worker or friend.
omens.omen_zh: 与同事或朋友设定一个明确的界限。
omens.detail_en: Separation is sometimes the path to harmony. Define where you end and others begin to preserve your focus.
omens.detail_zh: 有时分离是为了更好的和谐。明确自己的边界，能有效保护你的专注力。

omens.omen_en: Work from a different location to gain independence.
omens.omen_zh: 换个地方办公，找回那份独立感。
omens.detail_en: Breaking a routine connection forces self-reliance. Today, solitude is your greatest competitive advantage.
omens.detail_zh: 打破常规的依赖能强迫自我独立。今日，独处是你最强大的竞争优势。

omens.omen_en: Collect on a debt or ask for a long-awaited favor.
omens.omen_zh: 收回欠款，或请求一个期待已久的帮助。
omens.detail_en: Harvesting honey is about reaping rewards. Today is the day to collect the 'sweetness' you have worked for.
omens.detail_zh: 割蜜意在收获果实。今日适合去采摘那些你此前辛勤耕耘所积攒的‘甜头’。

omens.omen_en: Review your savings and enjoy the progress you've made.
omens.omen_zh: 查看你的储蓄，享受你已经取得的进展。
omens.detail_en: Take a moment to acknowledge your abundance. Recognizing your gains encourages more to flow in.
omens.detail_zh: 花点时间确认你的富足。认可已有的收获，会吸引更多财富流向你。

omens.omen_en: Begin the first draft of your most ambitious project.
omens.omen_zh: 为那个最有野心的项目写下第一份草稿。
omens.detail_en: Breaking ground is the start of creation. Don't worry about perfection; just start the transformation today.
omens.detail_zh: 动土是创造的开端。不要担心不完美，今日只需开启转化的第一步。

omens.omen_en: Deep clean a corner of your room you've ignored.
omens.omen_zh: 深度清理房间里那个一直被你忽视的角落。
omens.detail_en: Disturbing the dust clears the path. A literal or metaphorical deep dive into your 'ground' brings hidden treasures.
omens.detail_zh: 惊动尘土方能清空路径。对你的‘地盘’进行深度挖掘，会带来意想不到的收获。

omens.omen_en: Commit to a long-term partnership or contract.
omens.omen_zh: 承诺一份长期的合作伙伴关系或签署合同。
omens.detail_en: Auspicious for union and agreement. Today is a strong day to lock in a 'win-win' collaboration.
omens.detail_zh: 今日利于结合与协议。这是锁定双赢合作、达成长期契约的吉日。

omens.omen_en: Sync your goals with a partner to ensure alignment.
omens.omen_zh: 与伴侣或搭档同步目标，确保步调一致。
omens.detail_en: Unity is power. Merging your vision with another person today creates an unshakeable foundation for the future.
omens.detail_zh: 团结就是力量。今日将你的愿景与他人融合，能为未来打下不可撼动的基石。

omens.omen_en: Update your insurance or long-term safety net.
omens.omen_zh: 更新你的保险计划或长期安全保障。
omens.detail_en: Preparing for the inevitable brings peace of mind. Today is auspicious for securing your future 'casing' and protection.
omens.detail_zh: 未雨绸缪方能心安。今日最宜加固你的未来保障体系，为不可预知的未来做好准备。

omens.omen_en: Invest in high-quality furniture that will last a lifetime.
omens.omen_zh: 投资一件可以伴随你一生的优质家具。
omens.detail_en: Anciently about preparing a casket; modernly about investing in durable, long-term craftsmanship for your life.
omens.detail_zh: 古代指制作寿材；现代宜投资那些工艺精良、能经受时间考验的长久之物。

omens.omen_en: Finalize the overarching logic of your current project.
omens.omen_zh: 敲定你目前项目的核心底层逻辑。
omens.detail_en: The ridgepole connects the two sides of a roof. Today is perfect for unifying your separate ideas into one solid strategy.
omens.detail_zh: 屋脊连接屋顶两侧。今日最适合将你零散的想法统一成一个坚实的战略整体。

omens.omen_en: Strengthen your core values or personal boundaries.
omens.omen_zh: 加固你的核心价值观或个人底线。
omens.detail_en: A strong ridge protects the whole house. Aligning your actions with your 'backbone' today ensures long-term integrity.
omens.detail_zh: 脊梁强韧则全屋稳固。今日宜言行合一，加固你的内在准则，确保长期的正直与稳定。

omens.omen_en: Audit your privacy settings and secure your data.
omens.omen_zh: 审计你的隐私设置，确保数据安全。
omens.detail_en: Closing the curtains is about privacy. Use today to create a 'digital veil' around your personal information.
omens.detail_zh: 合帐意在保护隐私。今日宜为你的个人信息建立一道‘数字屏障’，确保私密性。

omens.omen_en: Set a dedicated 'off-time' for your devices tonight.
omens.omen_zh: 为今晚的电子设备设定一个明确的‘下班时间’。
omens.detail_en: Creating a boundary for sleep ensures recovery. Shield your rest from the noise of the outside world today.
omens.detail_zh: 为睡眠设定边界方能有效恢复。今日宜屏蔽外界噪音，保护你宝贵的休息时间。

omens.omen_en: Tear down an old system that is no longer working.
omens.omen_zh: 拆除一个已经失效的旧系统或旧习惯。
omens.detail_en: Breaking down a wall makes room for a better one. Don't fear the destruction; it is the first step of renovation.
omens.detail_zh: 推倒旧墙是为了筑起新墙。不要畏惧破坏，这是优化升级的第一步。

omens.omen_en: Unsubscribe from emails that no longer add value.
omens.omen_zh: 退订那些不再为你产生价值的邮件列表。
omens.detail_en: Removing the barriers to your focus is auspicious. Clear out the 'clutter' that blocks your daily view.
omens.detail_zh: 清除影响专注的障碍是明智之举。今日宜清理那些阻挡你视野的数字碎片。

omens.omen_en: Update your brand logo or social media profile picture.
omens.omen_zh: 更新你的品牌标志或社交媒体头像。
omens.detail_en: Sculpting and painting is about defining an image. Today is lucky for refining how you are perceived by others.
omens.detail_zh: 塑绘意在定义形象。今日利于修饰你的‘对外名片’，完善外界对你的第一印象。

omens.omen_en: Visualize your goals by creating a vision board.
omens.omen_zh: 通过制作愿景板来可视化你的目标。
omens.detail_en: Giving shape to your thoughts makes them real. Use creative visuals today to cement your future intentions.
omens.detail_zh: 赋予想法形状能让其变为现实。今日宜用视觉化的方式锁定你未来的意图。

omens.omen_en: Fix the minor bugs or 'leaks' in your current workflow.
omens.omen_zh: 修复目前工作流中的小漏洞或‘泄压点’。
omens.detail_en: Plugging the holes prevents loss. Address the small inefficiencies today before they become big problems.
omens.detail_zh: 堵住漏洞方能防止流失。今日宜解决微小的低效环节，防微杜渐。

omens.omen_en: Finalize your taxes or settle any pending paperwork.
omens.omen_zh: 清缴税款或处理任何悬而未决的文件事项。
omens.detail_en: Closing open loops brings immense relief. Today is auspicious for 'capping' tasks that have been draining your energy.
omens.detail_zh: 闭环能带来巨大的解脱感。今日宜完成那些一直消耗你精力的琐碎任务。

omens.omen_en: Reset your bedroom environment for optimal rest.
omens.omen_zh: 重新整理卧室环境以获得最佳休息体验。
omens.detail_en: A stable bed leads to a stable mind. Today is the best day to prioritize the quality of your recovery.
omens.detail_zh: 卧安则神稳。今日是提升睡眠质量、优化恢复环境的最佳时机。

omens.omen_en: Commit to a consistent sleep-wake schedule today.
omens.omen_zh: 今日起承诺执行一套稳定的睡眠作息表。
omens.detail_en: Establishing a rhythm is the foundation of health. Lock in your rest patterns to boost your creative energy.
omens.detail_zh: 建立节奏是健康的基石。固定你的休息模式，能有效提升你的创造力。

omens.omen_en: Install a new productivity app or hardware tool.
omens.omen_zh: 安装一款新的生产力应用或硬件工具。
omens.detail_en: Setting up machinery expands your capabilities. Today is favored for integrating technology into your life.
omens.detail_zh: 安设机械意在扩展能力。今日利于将新技术整合进你的生活与工作。

omens.omen_en: Optimize your computer's performance and startup settings.
omens.omen_zh: 优化电脑性能并清理开机启动项。
omens.detail_en: Ensuring your 'tools' run smoothly is vital. A quick tech calibration today ensures you move without friction.
omens.detail_zh: 确保‘工欲善其事’。今日对生产工具进行校准与优化，能让你接下来的行动毫无阻力。

omens.omen_en: Fully archive a project and stop thinking about it.
omens.omen_zh: 彻底归档一个项目，不再对其魂牵梦绕。
omens.detail_en: Proper burial allows for peaceful rebirth. Formally ending a chapter today lets your focus shift to the new.
omens.detail_zh: 妥善的终结方能开启重生。今日正式结束一个篇章，让你的专注力彻底转向新目标。

omens.omen_en: Perform a 'digital cleanup' of old, useless files.
omens.omen_zh: 对陈旧且无用的文件进行一次‘数字大清理’。
omens.detail_en: Removing the dead weight lightens your load. Clear out the artifacts of the past to speed up your future.
omens.detail_zh: 卸下包袱方能轻装上阵。清空过去的遗迹，能大幅提升你通往未来的速度。

omens.omen_en: Assemble that new piece of furniture or equipment.
omens.omen_zh: 组装那件新买的家具或专业设备。
omens.detail_en: Bringing tools into their final form is satisfying. Completing the setup today makes your environment work for you.
omens.detail_zh: 赋予工具完整的形态。今日完成环境配置，能让空间更好地为你服务。

omens.omen_en: Set up a new smart-home or automation routine.
omens.omen_zh: 设置一套新的智能家居或自动化工作流。
omens.detail_en: Automation is the modern 'appliance'. Today is lucky for creating systems that save you time and effort.
omens.detail_zh: 自动化是现代的‘器具’。今日宜建立省时省力的系统，让技术代劳琐事。

omens.omen_en: Set a new boundary for your personal accessibility.
omens.omen_zh: 为你的个人社交触达设定一个新的边界。
omens.detail_en: Installing a door controls who enters your space. Today is auspicious for deciding when to be 'open' and when to be 'closed' to distractions.
omens.detail_zh: 安门意在掌控空间的进出。今日最宜决定何时‘对外开放’，以及何时‘关门’屏蔽干扰。

omens.omen_en: Update the security and passwords for your main accounts.
omens.omen_zh: 更新你主要账号的安全设置与密码。
omens.detail_en: A strong door is the first line of defense. Strengthening your digital 'gate' today ensures your assets remain secure.
omens.detail_zh: 坚固的门是第一道防线。今日加固你的数字‘门户’，能确保你的资产万无一失。

omens.omen_en: Verify the core assumptions of your business plan.
omens.omen_zh: 验证你商业计划中最核心的底层假设。
omens.detail_en: Setting the foundation stone is critical for weight-bearing. Today is lucky for stress-testing your most basic ideas.
omens.detail_zh: 定磉是承重的关键。今日利于对你最基础的想法进行‘压力测试’，确保基石稳固。

omens.omen_en: Invest in a high-quality base for your tech setup.
omens.omen_zh: 为你的一整套办公设备投资一个高品质的底座。
omens.detail_en: A stable base prevents long-term tilt. Ensuring your physical or digital 'foundation' is level today ensures future growth.
omens.detail_zh: 稳固的基座能防止长期的倾斜。今日确保你的物理或数字‘基础’水平，能保障未来的增长。

omens.omen_en: Announce your new project to the public today.
omens.omen_zh: 今日宜正式向公众发布你的新项目。
omens.detail_en: The energy of 'opening' is at its peak. Today is the best day to invite outside energy and resources into your work.
omens.detail_zh: ‘开’的能量正值巅峰。今日是吸引外部能量与资源进入你的事业领域的最佳时机。

omens.omen_en: Send out your first invoice or launch a sales campaign.
omens.omen_zh: 发出你的第一张发票，或启动一场促销活动。
omens.detail_en: The flow of commerce is favored. Opening your 'doors' to revenue today sets a prosperous tone for the month.
omens.detail_zh: 商业流转受吉星庇佑。今日开启营收之门，能为本月奠定繁荣的基调。

omens.omen_en: Review your inventory and optimize your storage.
omens.omen_zh: 清点你的库存并优化你的仓储空间。
omens.detail_en: Opening the granary is about managing wealth. Today is auspicious for organizing your resources to prevent waste.
omens.detail_zh: 开仓关乎财富管理。今日最宜整理你的资源储备，通过优化管理来防止浪费。

omens.omen_en: Withdraw funds to invest in a tangible asset.
omens.omen_zh: 提取部分资金，用于投资一项实物资产。
omens.detail_en: Using your reserves to fuel growth is lucky today. It is a good day to turn 'stored' value into 'active' value.
omens.detail_zh: 今日宜动用储备来驱动增长。将‘储存’的价值转化为‘活跃’的价值是明智之举。

omens.omen_en: Go live with a final version of your software or site.
omens.omen_zh: 将你的软件或网站的最终版本正式上线。
omens.detail_en: Consecration gives a project its 'soul'. Today is perfect for letting your work finally meet its audience.
omens.detail_zh: 开光赋予项目‘灵魂’。今日最适合让你的作品正式与受众见面，赋予其生命力。

omens.omen_en: Take a high-quality professional headshot today.
omens.omen_zh: 今天宜拍摄一张高水准的职业形象照。
omens.detail_en: This is about 'opening the eyes' to the world. A clear, powerful image of yourself today will attract the right eyes.
omens.detail_zh: 此项活动意在向世界‘展示真容’。今日一张清晰、有力的个人形象照能吸引正确的目光。

omens.omen_en: Perform a deep audit of your worst habits.
omens.omen_zh: 对自己最坏的习惯进行一次深度的‘审计’。
omens.detail_en: Managing waste is essential for health. Today is auspicious for identifying and flushing out systems that drain your time.
omens.detail_zh: 处理废弃物对健康至关重要。今日利于识别并清除那些长期消耗你时间的无用系统。

omens.omen_en: Fix a long-ignored technical debt in your codebase.
omens.omen_zh: 修复代码库中一个被忽视已久的技术债。
omens.detail_en: Clearing out the 'plumbing' improves performance. Addressing the messiest part of your work today brings long-term relief.
omens.detail_zh: 疏通‘管道’能提升整体性能。今日着手处理工作中最凌乱的部分，能带来长期的轻松感。

omens.omen_en: Look for the hidden gaps in your current strategy.
omens.omen_zh: 寻找你现有战略中隐藏的漏洞或缺口。
omens.detail_en: Preparing the joints is about alignment. Finding where things don't 'fit' today prevents a collapse later.
omens.detail_zh: 开柱眼是为了精准衔接。今日发现那些‘不契合’的地方，能防止日后的架构崩塌。

omens.omen_en: Schedule a detailed 1-on-1 with a key team member.
omens.omen_zh: 与团队的关键成员安排一次深入的一对一交流。
omens.detail_en: Precision connection is favored. Opening up the 'slots' for better communication ensures a stronger team structure.
omens.detail_zh: 今日利于精准的链接。开启深度沟通的‘接口’，能确保团队结构更加稳固。

omens.omen_en: Create a new 'collection' for your creative research.
omens.omen_zh: 为你的创意调研建立一个新的‘素材库’。
omens.detail_en: A pond stores life-giving water. Today is lucky for creating a digital reservoir where you can save ideas for later.
omens.detail_zh: 池塘储备生命之水。今日利于建立数字化的‘灵感水库’，为日后的创作积蓄力量。

omens.omen_en: Take a long bath or visit a pool to reset your energy.
omens.omen_zh: 通过泡澡或去游泳馆来重置你的内在能量。
omens.detail_en: Immersing in water facilitates emotional release. Today, water-based activities will wash away stagnant stress.
omens.detail_zh: 沉浸于水中利于情绪释放。今日与水相关的活动能洗去积压的压力，让能量复原。

omens.omen_en: Automate a repetitive task to speed up your workflow.
omens.omen_zh: 通过自动化处理一项重复性任务，提速工作流。
omens.detail_en: Opening a channel directs the flow. Today is auspicious for creating paths that move information automatically.
omens.detail_zh: 开渠意在引导流动。今日最利于建立自动化的信息通道，让效率自然流转。

omens.omen_en: Clear the path for a stuck payment or project.
omens.omen_zh: 为一个停滞不前的项目或款项扫清障碍。
omens.detail_en: Removing the blockage allows the current to return. Use today to identify the one thing stopping the flow and remove it.
omens.detail_zh: 移除障碍方能让水流回归。今日宜找出那个阻碍进展的单一因素，并果断解决它。

omens.omen_en: Draft a 'five-year plan' for your personal growth.
omens.omen_zh: 为你的个人成长起草一份‘五年计划’。
omens.detail_en: Anciently about preparing a future resting place while alive. Modernly, it is a day for far-sighted planning that secures your future legacy.
omens.detail_zh: 古代指生前营建寿域。在现代，这是进行远景规划、锁定未来个人成就的吉日。

omens.omen_en: Invest in a long-term retirement or pension fund.
omens.omen_zh: 投资一份长期的退休金或养老基金。
omens.detail_en: Providing for the distant future brings peace to the present. Today is lucky for financial moves that benefit the 'future you'.
omens.detail_zh: 为遥远的未来做准备能带来当下的安宁。今日利于那些能让‘未来的你’受益的财务决策。

omens.omen_en: Reconnect with your roots or visit your hometown.
omens.omen_zh: 回归本源，或者回一趟老家。
omens.detail_en: Returning home refreshes the spirit. Today, connecting with your origins provides the emotional fuel needed for your next journey.
omens.detail_zh: 归宁是精神的充电。今日与本源建立联系，能为你下一段征程提供必要的情感燃料。

omens.omen_en: Call a family member to share your recent progress.
omens.omen_zh: 给家里人打个电话，分享你最近的进展。
omens.detail_en: Maintaining foundational ties strengthens your resolve. A simple conversation with your support system today brings immense clarity.
omens.detail_zh: 维持根基性的联系能坚定你的意志。今日与支持你的人进行简单的交流，能带来极大的思维清晰度。

omens.omen_en: Retreat from social media for a deep mental reset.
omens.omen_zh: 从社交媒体中抽身，进行一次深度的精神重置。
omens.detail_en: Like clouds returning to the cave, today is for heading inward. Silence the noise to hear your own inner voice.
omens.detail_zh: 如云归山岫，今日宜向内求索。屏除外界噪音，方能听见内心最真实的渴望。

omens.omen_en: End a period of travel and focus on home life.
omens.omen_zh: 结束一段时间的奔波，将重心转回家庭生活。
omens.detail_en: Returning to your 'nest' is favored. Stability after movement allows you to integrate the lessons you've learned on the road.
omens.detail_zh: 归巢之举倍受庇佑。动之后的静，能让你更好地消化并吸收在旅途中学到的见闻。

omens.omen_en: Take full responsibility for a recent mistake.
omens.omen_zh: 为最近的一个错误承担起全部责任。
omens.detail_en: Coming of age is about accountability. Today, owning your actions upgrades your professional status in the eyes of others.
omens.detail_zh: 成人的核心是担当。今日承担责任的举动，将显著提升你在他人眼中的职业成熟度。

omens.omen_en: Complete a task that marks your transition to a new level.
omens.omen_zh: 完成一项标志着你迈向新台阶的任务。
omens.detail_en: Auspicious for 'stepping up'. Finish that difficult certification or project that proves you have entered the next league.
omens.detail_zh: 今日利于‘晋级’。完成那项艰巨的认证或项目，以此证明你已进入了更高阶的圈层。

omens.omen_en: Formally accept a major change in your life.
omens.omen_zh: 正式接纳生活中发生的一项重大改变。
omens.detail_en: Accepting a transition allows you to process it. Today is a day for mental fortitude and facing reality with grace.
omens.detail_zh: 接纳变迁方能消化变迁。今日宜展现心理韧性，以优雅的姿态直面现实的转折。

omens.omen_en: Commit to a period of discipline or focused study.
omens.omen_zh: 开启一段自律期或专注的学习期。
omens.detail_en: Putting on the 'uniform' signifies a shift in state. Today is lucky for adopting a stricter routine for a specific goal.
omens.detail_zh: 披上‘战袍’意味着状态的转变。今日宜针对特定目标，开启一套更为严格的日常作息。

omens.omen_en: Organize your desktop and physical workspace.
omens.omen_zh: 整理你的电脑桌面和实体办公空间。
omens.detail_en: External order reflects internal order. Clearing the dust from your environment today sharpens your decision-making.
omens.detail_zh: 外在的秩序映射内在的条理。今日清空环境中的尘埃，能让你的决策力更加敏锐。

omens.omen_en: Perform a deep digital cleanup of your inbox.
omens.omen_zh: 对你的电子邮箱进行一次深度的数字大扫除。
omens.detail_en: Clearing out the old creates space for the new. An organized system today ensures no opportunity is missed tomorrow.
omens.detail_zh: 清理旧物方能为新物腾位。今日优化的系统，能确保你明天不会错过任何机会。

omens.omen_en: Sweep away the minor distractions from your day.
omens.omen_zh: 扫除今天那些分散你注意力的琐碎小事。
omens.detail_en: Daily cleaning prevents buildup. Use today to handle the small, nagging tasks that are clouding your focus.
omens.detail_zh: 日常清扫能防患于未然。今日宜处理那些消耗精力的琐碎小事，换取片刻的专注。

omens.omen_en: Donate or recycle items that no longer serve you.
omens.omen_zh: 捐赠或回收那些不再为你产生价值的物品。
omens.detail_en: Letting go of clutter invites abundance. Today is auspicious for removing things that have outlived their purpose.
omens.detail_zh: 断舍离能引来富足。今日最宜移除那些使命已达、不再被需要的陈旧之物。

omens.omen_en: Launch a wide-reaching lead generation campaign.
omens.omen_zh: 启动一场覆盖范围广泛的线索获取活动。
omens.detail_en: Casting a net is about volume and patience. Today is auspicious for activities that bring in a high quantity of new leads.
omens.detail_zh: 撒网讲求广度与耐心。今日利于那些能为你带回大量潜在客户或新线索的活动。

omens.omen_en: Scroll through forums to find new customer pain points.
omens.omen_zh: 浏览各大论坛，寻找客户的新痛点。
omens.detail_en: Gathering insights from the 'pool' of public opinion is favored. Use today to listen to what the market is asking for.
omens.detail_zh: 从大众舆论的‘池塘’中获取洞见受吉星庇佑。今日宜倾听市场最真实的需求声音。

omens.omen_en: Deconstruct a complex problem into smaller parts.
omens.omen_zh: 将一个复杂的问题拆解成更小的、可操作的部分。
omens.detail_en: To build something better, you must understand its components. Today is lucky for taking things apart to find a better way.
omens.detail_zh: 欲善其事，必先解其构。今日利于拆解现状，从内部结构中寻找更优的路径。

omens.omen_en: Dismantle an old project and reuse its best pieces.
omens.omen_zh: 拆除一个旧项目，并回收利用其中最精华的部分。
omens.detail_en: Resourcefulness is favored today. Don't waste the 'parts' of the past; integrate them into your future build.
omens.detail_zh: 今日利于资源的灵活性运用。不要浪费过去的精华，将其整合进你未来的蓝图中。

omens.omen_en: Publicly announce your new title or brand name today.
omens.omen_zh: 今日宜正式公布你的新头衔或品牌名称。
omens.detail_en: Hanging a plaque is about public recognition. Today is auspicious for solidifying your identity in the eyes of the world.
omens.detail_zh: 挂匾象征着公众认可。今日最宜向外界确立你的身份，提升品牌或个人的社会地位。

omens.omen_en: Add your most impressive achievement to your bio.
omens.omen_zh: 将你最引以为傲的成就更新在个人简介中。
omens.detail_en: Displaying excellence attracts opportunity. Use today to showcase your 'prestige' to potential collaborators.
omens.detail_zh: 展示卓越方能吸引机遇。今日宜公开你的‘高光时刻’，以此赢得合作伙伴的青睐。

omens.omen_en: Investigate a new primary source of information.
omens.omen_zh: 去挖掘一个新的、第一手的信息来源。
omens.detail_en: A well provides long-term sustenance. Today is lucky for establishing a 'well' of knowledge that will feed your career for years.
omens.detail_zh: 井水长流，受用不尽。今日利于建立一个知识库，为你的职业生涯提供长期的养分。

omens.omen_en: Automate your recurring savings or investments.
omens.omen_zh: 为你的定期储蓄或投资设置自动化流转。
omens.detail_en: Creating a 'flow' of wealth ensures security. Today is favored for setting up systems that gather resources quietly in the background.
omens.detail_zh: 建立财富流向方能确保安全。今日宜设置那些能默默为你积攒资源的自动化系统。

omens.omen_en: Rearrange your furniture to shift the room's energy.
omens.omen_zh: 重新布置家具位置，置换空间能量。
omens.detail_en: A change of environment sparks a change of mind. Moving your physical position today breaks a mental stalemate.
omens.detail_zh: 环境的迁徙能带动思维的转化。今日改变物理位置，能有效打破心理上的僵局。

omens.omen_en: Start working from a new cafe or co-working space.
omens.omen_zh: 尝试去一家新的咖啡馆或共享空间办公。
omens.detail_en: The universe favors movement and new perspectives. A fresh backdrop today will lead to a fresh set of ideas.
omens.detail_zh: 宇宙今日利于迁徙与新视角。身处全新的背景板下，能激发出一整套全新的创意。

omens.omen_en: Launch a project on a brand new platform.
omens.omen_zh: 在一个全新的平台上启动你的项目。
omens.detail_en: Moving into a new home is a total reset. Today is powerful for migrating your work to a superior system or community.
omens.detail_zh: 迁入新居是彻底的重置。今日最利于将你的工作迁移到更先进的系统或圈层中。

omens.omen_en: Deep clean and 'consecrate' your new workspace.
omens.omen_zh: 深度清扫并‘赋予’你新办公区一种仪式感。
omens.detail_en: Establishing a new base requires fresh energy. Clear the air in your new 'home' today to ensure long-term prosperity.
omens.detail_zh: 建立新基地需要新鲜能量。今日宜净化新空间的氛围，以此确保长期的兴旺。

omens.omen_en: Onboard a new mentee or hire a promising intern.
omens.omen_zh: 开始带一名新徒弟，或入职一位有潜力的实习生。
omens.detail_en: Adoption is about expanding your circle with intention. Today is lucky for taking someone under your wing for future growth.
omens.detail_zh: 收养是带着意图扩展圈层。今日利于提携后辈，通过悉心指导为未来种下善果。

omens.omen_en: Adopt a new creative 'pet project' that needs care.
omens.omen_zh: 开启一个需要悉心呵护的全新‘趣味项目’。
omens.detail_en: Nurturing something small leads to big joy. Use today to commit to a project that brings out your protective and creative instincts.
omens.detail_zh: 滋养微小事物能带来巨大愉悦。今日宜开启一个让你充满保护欲与创作欲的新尝试。

omens.omen_en: Finalize a large payment or release a budget.
omens.omen_zh: 结算一笔大额款项，或批准一项预算。
omens.detail_en: Releasing water is about directing flow. Today is auspicious for letting resources out so that they can do their work in the world.
omens.detail_zh: 放水意在引导流向。今日最宜释放资源，让资金或能量流向它该去的地方发挥价值。

omens.omen_en: Share your expertise for free in a public forum.
omens.omen_zh: 在公开论坛上免费分享你的专业见解。
omens.detail_en: Generosity is the best way to move energy. Today, 'letting your knowledge flow' will eventually return to you as prestige.
omens.detail_zh: 慷慨是驱动能量的最佳方式。今日宜‘倾囊相授’，这份知识的流动终会化为声望回归。

omens.omen_en: Update your team's standard operating procedures.
omens.omen_zh: 更新你团队的标准作业程序（SOP）。
omens.detail_en: Training animals was about optimizing productivity. Today, training your 'systems' ensures you get the most out of your hours.
omens.detail_zh: 驯养牧畜是为了优化产能。今日宜‘驯化’你的工作系统，确保每一分钟都能产出最大价值。

omens.omen_en: Learn a shortcut or a new set of keyboard commands.
omens.omen_zh: 学习一个新的快捷键组合或指令集。
omens.detail_en: Mastering your tools is a form of 'training'. Today is lucky for sharpening your interface with the machines you use daily.
omens.detail_zh: 精通工具也是一种‘驯服’。今日利于磨练你与生产工具之间的默契，提升操作流程度。

omens.omen_en: Schedule a total digital detox for the evening.
omens.omen_zh: 为今晚安排一次彻底的‘数字斋戒’。
omens.detail_en: Ritual cleansing purifies the spirit. Today is auspicious for a period of mental 'fasting' from information and noise.
omens.detail_zh: 斋醮意在净化精神。今日利于进行一段时间的信息‘斋戒’，屏除杂念以清空大脑。

omens.omen_en: Reflect on your values and align your work accordingly.
omens.omen_zh: 反思你的价值观，并据此调整你的工作方向。
omens.detail_en: Connecting with the higher purpose brings peace. Today is a strong day for prayer, meditation, or philosophical deep-dives.
omens.detail_zh: 连接更高远的使命能带来安宁。今日适合祈祷、冥想或进行深度的哲学思考。

omens.omen_en: Unsubscribe from the bottom 10% of your notifications.
omens.omen_zh: 退订那些最没用的最后 10% 的通知提醒。
omens.detail_en: Eliminating ants prevents a future infestation. Today is for cutting off the small, persistent 'pests' that drain your focus.
omens.detail_zh: 断蚁意在杜绝后患。今日宜切断那些细小但持久、不断蚕食你专注力的‘信息干扰’。

omens.omen_en: Identify and block a minor leak in your monthly budget.
omens.omen_zh: 识别并堵住每月预算中一个小额的‘出血点’。
omens.detail_en: Tiny leaks can sink big ships. Stopping a small, recurring expense today ensures your long-term wealth stays intact.
omens.detail_zh: 千里之堤毁于蚁穴。今日堵住一个细小的经常性开支，能确保你的长期财富不受侵蚀。

omens.omen_en: Donate to a cause or help a stranger without expecting a return.
omens.omen_zh: 今日宜随缘布施，或不求回报地帮助一名陌生人。
omens.detail_en: Universal salvation is about balancing the collective energy. A selfless act today clears your own path of hidden obstacles.
omens.detail_zh: 普渡意在平衡集体能量。今日的一份无私善举，能为你未来的道路扫清隐形障碍。

omens.omen_en: Offer a word of encouragement to someone struggling online.
omens.omen_zh: 给正在经历困难的网友留下一句鼓励的话。
omens.detail_en: Compassion is a high-vibration frequency. Sharing your 'light' today attracts positive synchronicity back into your life.
omens.detail_zh: 慈悲是一种高频能量。今日分享你的光芒，会为你吸引正面的人事物回流。

omens.omen_en: Set up a temporary pilot program for your new idea.
omens.omen_zh: 为你的新想法搭建一个临时的‘试点项目’。
omens.detail_en: Building a scaffold is about supporting growth. Today is lucky for creating a 'test frame' before you commit to the final build.
omens.detail_zh: 架马是为了给成长提供支撑。今日宜搭建一个测试框架，在正式投入前先验证可行性。

omens.omen_en: Collaborate with a specialist to bridge a technical gap.
omens.omen_zh: 与专业人士协作，填补你技术上的短板。
omens.detail_en: Support structures make the impossible possible. Use today to lean on someone else's expertise to reach a higher level.
omens.detail_zh: 支撑结构让不可能变为可能。今日宜借助他人的专长，助你跃上更高的台阶。

omens.omen_en: Start a new project that will take months to mature.
omens.omen_zh: 启动一个需要数月时间才能成熟的新项目。
omens.detail_en: Planting is an act of faith in the future. Today is the best day to sow a seed that requires patience but yields massive fruit.
omens.detail_zh: 栽种是对未来的信任。今日最宜播下一颗需要耐心呵护、但回报丰厚的‘长期种子’。

omens.omen_en: Buy a plant for your desk to improve your air and mood.
omens.omen_zh: 为办公桌买一盆绿植，改善空气与心情。
omens.detail_en: Nurturing life brings life back to you. Adding a living element to your workspace today boosts your creative vitality.
omens.detail_zh: 滋养生命，生命亦会回馈于你。今日为办公空间增添生机，能显著提升创作活力。

omens.omen_en: Book a long-overdue checkup or physical therapy session.
omens.omen_zh: 预约一次拖延已久的体检或理疗项目。
omens.detail_en: The universe favors proactive healing today. Addressing a small discomfort now prevents a major breakdown later.
omens.detail_zh: 今日宇宙利于主动疗愈。现在着手处理那些细小的不适，能预防日后的大麻烦。

omens.omen_en: Consult an expert about a problem you can't solve alone.
omens.omen_zh: 就一个你无法独立解决的问题咨询行业专家。
omens.detail_en: Seeking help is a sign of wisdom, not weakness. Professional advice today will save you weeks of trial and error.
omens.detail_zh: 求助是智慧而非软弱。今日的一份专业建议，能为你节省数周的试错成本。

omens.omen_en: Focus on your legacy and what you want to create next.
omens.omen_zh: 思考你的长期影响，以及你接下来的创作目标。
omens.detail_en: This energy is about fertility and continuation. It's a powerful day to conceive a 'brainchild' or a new creative vision.
omens.detail_zh: 此能量关乎繁衍与延续。今日最宜孕育一个新的‘创意结晶’或宏大的创作愿景。

omens.omen_en: Nurture your inner child through a playful activity.
omens.omen_zh: 通过有趣的活动来滋养你的‘内在小孩’。
omens.detail_en: To create the new, you must remain young at heart. Today, a playful approach to a difficult task will lead to success.
omens.detail_zh: 欲创万象，必存童心。今日用玩乐的心态去面对难题，反而更容易获得成功。

omens.omen_en: Submit your application to a company that inspires you.
omens.omen_zh: 向那家让你心生向往的公司递交你的申请。
omens.detail_en: Doors of opportunity are swinging open. Today is auspicious for putting your name forward into a new community or role.
omens.detail_zh: 机遇之门正在缓缓开启。今日利于将你的名号投向新的圈层或职位，寻求突破。

omens.omen_en: Sign up for a certification that validates your expertise.
omens.omen_zh: 报名一项能证明你专业水准的资格认证。
omens.detail_en: Entering a new 'school' of thought is favored. Formalizing your education today increases your future earning power.
omens.detail_zh: 进入新的‘学术门派’受吉星庇佑。今日将你的教育背景正式化，能提升未来的议价能力。

omens.omen_en: Perform a 'brain dump' and clear your mental clutter.
omens.omen_zh: 进行一次‘脑力倾倒’，清空你的心理杂念。
omens.detail_en: Bathing is about purification. Washing away stagnant thoughts today allows fresh, clear ideas to emerge.
omens.detail_zh: 沐浴意在净化。今日洗去积压的旧思想，能让清新且明晰的创意浮现。

omens.omen_en: Turn off your phone for a long, meditative shower.
omens.omen_zh: 关掉手机，享受一次长长的冥想式沐浴。
omens.detail_en: Water resets your bio-field. A mindful cleanse today will remove the 'static' of a stressful week.
omens.detail_zh: 水能重置你的生物场。今日一份专注的洗练，能帮你洗掉一整周压力积攒的‘静电’。

omens.omen_en: Implement a radical 'fix' for a recurring system bug.
omens.omen_zh: 为反复出现的系统漏洞实施一次彻底的‘修复’。
omens.detail_en: Treating the illness requires finding the root. Use today to perform 'surgery' on a part of your life that isn't working.
omens.detail_zh: 治病求本。今日宜对你生活中那些失效的部分进行一次彻底的‘手术’式整改。

omens.omen_en: Cut out one habit that you know is harming your focus.
omens.omen_zh: 戒掉一个你明知正在损害你专注力的坏习惯。
omens.detail_en: Eliminating the cause is the only path to a cure. Today is lucky for quitting a vice and reclaiming your energy.
omens.detail_zh: 除病因方能断病根。今日利于戒除恶习，重新夺回你对自身能量的掌控权。

omens.omen_en: Check in on the progress of your long-term passive income.
omens.omen_zh: 检查你长期被动收入项目的进展情况。
omens.detail_en: Herding is about managing assets that grow. Today is favored for overseeing things that work for you while you sleep.
omens.detail_zh: 牧养关乎管理成长型资产。今日利于视察那些在你睡觉时也能为你工作的‘赚钱机器’。

omens.omen_en: Nurture your team by listening to their individual needs.
omens.omen_zh: 倾听团队成员的个人需求，给他们一份关怀。
omens.detail_en: A healthy flock requires care, not just management. Your leadership thrives today through empathy and support.
omens.detail_zh: 健康的‘羊群’需要呵护而非单纯管控。今日你的领导力将通过同理心与支持而得到升华。

omens.omen_en: Change your physical appearance to mark a fresh start.
omens.omen_zh: 改变你的外在形象，以此标志一个新的开始。
omens.detail_en: Cutting hair is an ancient symbol of shedding the past. A fresh look today signals to the world that you've evolved.
omens.detail_zh: 理发是剪除过去的古老象征。今日换个发型，能向世界发出你已进化升级的信号。

omens.omen_en: Trim the 'dead ends' of your project's feature list.
omens.omen_zh: 修剪掉项目功能列表中那些无用的‘分叉’。
omens.detail_en: Precision requires cutting away the excess. Today is lucky for streamlining your ideas to make them more manageable.
omens.detail_zh: 精准源自精简。今日利于剪掉那些冗余的想法，让你的项目更具可操控性。

omens.omen_en: Consolidate your different projects into one unified brand.
omens.omen_zh: 将你零散的项目整合进一个统一的品牌之下。
omens.detail_en: Building a house is about creating a singular protective shell. Today is favored for bringing all your efforts under one 'roof'.
omens.detail_zh: 盖屋意在打造一个统一的庇护壳。今日最利于将你的所有努力整合进同一个品牌主张之下。

omens.omen_en: Finalize the 'base architecture' of your digital platform.
omens.omen_zh: 敲定你数字化平台的‘基础架构’。
omens.detail_en: A roof protects the contents from the elements. Today, prioritize the security and stability of your system's core structure.
omens.detail_zh: 屋顶保护内部免受风雨。今日应优先考虑系统核心结构的安全性与稳定性。

omens.omen_en: Conduct a radical post-mortem on a failed initiative.
omens.omen_zh: 对一个失败的倡议进行一次彻底的‘复盘’。
omens.detail_en: Breaking ground for an 'end' is about learning from the earth. Deeply analyze past mistakes today to ensure they don't repeat.
omens.detail_zh: 破土涉及终结，意在从过往中吸取教训。今日深度分析旧错，方能确保其不再重演。

omens.omen_en: Delete the legacy code or files that are holding you back.
omens.omen_zh: 删除那些拖累你进展的旧代码或陈旧文件。
omens.detail_en: Clearing the space for a grave is about making room for memory. Remove the 'dead weight' today to lighten your future path.
omens.detail_zh: 为归宿清空空间。今日卸下‘死重’包袱，能有效减轻你通往未来的脚步。

omens.omen_en: Tear down a restrictive belief or outdated mental model.
omens.omen_zh: 拆除一个限制性的信念或陈旧的思维模型。
omens.detail_en: To rebuild, you must first demolish. Today is the perfect day to challenge and break a system that no longer fits your life.
omens.detail_zh: 欲重建必先拆除。今日最适合挑战并打破那个已经不再适合你生活的旧系统。

omens.omen_en: End a contract or lease that has become a burden.
omens.omen_zh: 终止一份已经成为负担的合同或租赁协议。
omens.detail_en: Dismantling a structure releases you from its constraints. Today, break the ties that bind you to a stagnant environment.
omens.detail_zh: 拆解旧结构能让你从束缚中解脱。今日宜切断那些将你困在停滞环境中的纽带。

omens.omen_en: Set a powerful intention for the month ahead.
omens.omen_zh: 为接下来的一个月设定一个强大的意图。
omens.detail_en: Aligning your will with the universe brings luck. Today, writing down your desires acts as a formal prayer for success.
omens.detail_zh: 将意志与宇宙对齐能带来好运。今日写下你的渴望，无异于为成功进行了一场正式的祈祷。

omens.omen_en: Practice gratitude by listing five things that went well.
omens.omen_zh: 通过列出五件进展顺利的事来练习感恩。
omens.detail_en: Attracting 'blessings' starts with noticing them. Today, focus on what is working to attract even more positive energy.
omens.detail_zh: 吸引‘福报’始于觉察。今日专注于那些顺利的事，能为你吸引更多正能量。

omens.omen_en: Pay tribute to a mentor or an inspiration in your field.
omens.omen_zh: 向你领域内的导师或灵感源泉致敬。
omens.detail_en: Honoring your lineage strengthens your own path. Acknowledging those who came before you builds cultural and social capital.
omens.detail_zh: 追溯本源能稳固自身道路。今日向先驱致敬，能为你积累深厚的文化与社交资本。

omens.omen_en: Reflect on your core 'Why' to reconnect with your passion.
omens.omen_zh: 反思你的核心‘初心’，重新找回创作热情。
omens.detail_en: Sacrifice is about giving to the source. Today, sacrifice your ego to reconnect with the pure joy of your craft.
omens.detail_zh: 祭祀是回归本源。今日宜放下小我，找回你投身这项事业最初的纯粹快乐。

omens.omen_en: Migrate your old data to a safer, modern server.
omens.omen_zh: 将你的旧数据迁移到更安全、更现代的服务器上。
omens.detail_en: Moving a casket is about a final, safe transition. Today is lucky for moving vital assets from an old system to a new one.
omens.detail_zh: 移柩是关于最终的稳妥转移。今日利于将关键资产从旧系统安全迁移至新系统。

omens.omen_en: Formalize the conclusion of a major business transition.
omens.omen_zh: 正式确立一项重大商业转型的最终结论。
omens.detail_en: Final movement brings final peace. Use today to complete a complex transition that has been 'in limbo' for too long.
omens.detail_zh: 最终的移动带来最终的安宁。今日宜完成那个悬而未决太久的复杂转型任务。

omens.omen_en: Create a 'Case Study' of your most successful project.
omens.omen_zh: 为你最成功的项目撰写一份‘案例研究’。
omens.detail_en: Erecting a monument makes your work permanent. Today is favored for documenting your wins so they stand the test of time.
omens.detail_zh: 立碑能让你的成就永恒。今日最宜记录你的胜绩，让其经受住时间的考验。

omens.omen_en: Register your trademark or buy a domain for your legacy.
omens.omen_zh: 注册你的商标，或为你的长久事业购买域名。
omens.detail_en: A monument marks your territory. Today is lucky for claiming a name or space that will define your career for years.
omens.detail_zh: 碑石标志着领地。今日利于占领那个能定义你多年职业生涯的名称或空间。

omens.omen_en: Hire a key leader or find a mentor for your business.
omens.omen_zh: 聘请一位关键领导者，或为你的事业寻找一位导师。
omens.detail_en: The pillars support the entire structure. Today is the best day to bring in 'structural' people who can bear the weight of growth.
omens.detail_zh: 柱石支撑全局。今日最宜引入那些能分担增长重任、具备‘支柱’属性的人才。

omens.omen_en: Define the unshakeable 'Pillars' of your personal brand.
omens.omen_zh: 定义你个人品牌中那些不可动摇的‘支柱’理念。
omens.detail_en: Stability requires vertical strength. Today, identify the 3-4 core values that will support every decision you make.
omens.detail_zh: 稳固源自纵向的力量。今日宜确立那 3-4 个核心价值观，让其支撑你的每一个决策。

omens.omen_en: Setup automated savings to protect against market flux.
omens.omen_zh: 设置自动化储蓄，以抵御市场波动的冲击。
omens.detail_en: Building a levee prevents flooding. Today is auspicious for creating financial or operational buffers before 'storms' arrive.
omens.detail_zh: 筑堤意在防洪。今日最宜在‘风暴’到来前，建立起财务或运营上的缓冲带。

omens.omen_en: Strengthen your data backup and recovery systems.
omens.omen_zh: 加固你的数据备份与恢复系统。
omens.detail_en: A strong dam manages energy. Ensuring your data is 'walled off' and safe today prevents a catastrophic loss later.
omens.detail_zh: 坚固的大坝能管理能量。今日确保数据已被‘高墙保护’，能预防未来的灾难性损失。

omens.omen_en: Sign that partnership agreement you've been debating.
omens.omen_zh: 签署那份你一直犹豫不决的合伙协议。
omens.detail_en: Commitment creates a new reality. Today the alignment of interests is high, leading to long-term prosperity through collaboration.
omens.detail_zh: 承诺创造现实。今日利益契合度极高，通过协作将带来长期的繁荣。

omens.omen_en: Finalize a deal with a new vendor or supplier.
omens.omen_zh: 与新的供应商或服务商敲定一项交易。
omens.detail_en: Solidifying your supply chain is favored today. A formal contract signed now ensures a reliable flow of resources.
omens.detail_zh: 加固供应链受吉星庇佑。今日签署正式合同，能确保资源的可靠流转。

omens.omen_en: Invite a new collaborator to join your inner creative circle.
omens.omen_zh: 邀请一位新的合作伙伴加入你的核心创意圈。
omens.detail_en: Anciently about bringing a son-in-law into the family. Modernly, it is a lucky day for integrating an outsider into your core mission or family business.
omens.detail_zh: 古代指招赘女婿。在现代，这是将外部人才整合进你的核心使命或家族事业的吉日。

omens.omen_en: Onboard a partner who brings resources you currently lack.
omens.omen_zh: 入职一位能带来你目前所稀缺资源的合伙人。
omens.detail_en: This is about strengthening your 'house' through union. Today is auspicious for alliances that fill your skill gaps.
omens.detail_zh: 此项活动意在通过联合来壮大‘门楣’。今日利于通过结盟来填补你的技能空白。

omens.omen_en: Invest in a tool or asset that generates passive value.
omens.omen_zh: 投资一个能产生被动价值的工具或资产。
omens.detail_en: Buying livestock was about acquiring productive assets. Today, focus on 'engines'—whether software or hardware—that work for you.
omens.detail_zh: 买入牲畜是为了获取生产性资产。今日宜关注那些能为你工作的‘引擎’，无论是软件还是硬件。

omens.omen_en: Adopt a new habit that will 'grow' your health or wealth.
omens.omen_zh: 养成一个能让你的健康或财富‘增值’的新习惯。
omens.detail_en: Nurturing something new leads to future abundance. Today is lucky for starting a routine that yields results over time.
omens.detail_zh: 滋养新事物会带来未来的富足。今日最宜开启一套随时间推移而产生复利效应的常规计划。

omens.omen_en: Collect outstanding payments or chase up invoices today.
omens.omen_zh: 今日宜收回欠款，或催收逾期发票。
omens.detail_en: The energy of 'receiving' is at its peak. Today is the best day to pull resources into your accounts and consolidate your gains.
omens.detail_zh: ‘收纳’的能量处于巅峰。今日是将资源汇入账簿、巩固收益的最佳时机。

omens.omen_en: Accept a new job offer or a high-value project quote.
omens.omen_zh: 接受一份新的工作邀约或高价值的项目报价。
omens.detail_en: Opening the door to wealth is favored today. Say yes to opportunities that increase your net worth.
omens.detail_zh: 开启财富之门受吉星庇佑。今日宜对那些能提升你净值的机会说‘好’。

omens.omen_en: Merge your efforts with a partner for a massive launch.
omens.omen_zh: 与合作伙伴合力，开启一次重大的发布活动。
omens.detail_en: Union creates exponential power. Today is lucky for 'marrying' two different ideas or brands to create something bigger.
omens.detail_zh: 联合能产生指数级的力量。今日利于将两个不同的创意或品牌‘联姻’，创造更大的价值。

omens.omen_en: Commit to a long-term professional or personal vow.
omens.omen_zh: 许下一个长期的职业或个人承诺。
omens.detail_en: The universe favors binding agreements today. Formalizing a deep commitment ensures it stands the test of time.
omens.detail_zh: 宇宙今日利于达成具有约束力的协议。正式化一个深层的承诺，能确保其经受住时间的考验。

omens.omen_en: Build a new automated sales funnel or mailing list.
omens.omen_zh: 搭建一个新的自动化销售漏斗或邮件列表。
omens.detail_en: Making a net is about preparing to catch opportunity. Today is for building systems that capture leads while you sleep.
omens.detail_zh: 结网意在准备捕获机遇。今日宜搭建那些能在你休息时自动捕捉潜在客户的系统。

omens.omen_en: Update your LinkedIn or professional networking profile.
omens.omen_zh: 更新你的 LinkedIn 或专业社交媒体资料。
omens.detail_en: Strengthening your 'web' connects you to more prey. Use today to broaden your professional reach and visibility.
omens.detail_zh: 加固你的‘关系网’能让你接触到更多机会。今日宜扩大你的职业影响范围和曝光度。

omens.omen_en: Take a 'maintenance day' to prevent creative burnout.
omens.omen_zh: 安排一个‘维护日’，预防创作倦怠。
omens.detail_en: Self-care is a prerequisite for performance. Grooming your physical self today refreshes your mental edge for the week ahead.
omens.detail_zh: 自我关怀是高效表现的前提。今日修饰仪容、放松身心，能为下周的工作磨利你的‘思维之刃’。

omens.omen_en: Pay attention to the small, aesthetic details of your project.
omens.omen_zh: 关注你项目中那些细微的美学细节。
omens.detail_en: Small refinements make a big difference. Today is lucky for 'polishing' the edges of your work until it shines.
omens.detail_zh: 细节决定成败。今日利于‘打磨’作品的边缘细节，直至其焕发光彩。

omens.omen_en: Fix the security vulnerabilities in your digital life.
omens.omen_zh: 修复你数字生活中的安全漏洞。
omens.detail_en: Mending a wall prevents loss. Today is auspicious for changing passwords or updating firewall settings.
omens.detail_zh: 补墙意在防范流失。今日最宜更改密码或更新防火墙设置，加固安全。

omens.omen_en: Mend a strained professional relationship with a short note.
omens.omen_zh: 通过简单的讯息，修复一段紧张的职场关系。
omens.detail_en: A small repair today prevents a total collapse tomorrow. Use today to patch up misunderstandings or gaps in communication.
omens.detail_zh: 今日的小修小补能防止明日的彻底崩塌。宜通过沟通弥合误解或信息断层。

omens.omen_en: Redesign your landing page or app interface for better UX.
omens.omen_zh: 重新设计你的落地页或 App 界面以提升用户体验。
omens.detail_en: Improving the 'facade' attracts better energy. Today is lucky for visual upgrades that make your work more inviting.
omens.detail_zh: 改善‘门面’能吸引更佳的能量。今日利于视觉升级，让你的作品更具吸引力。

omens.omen_en: Update your environment with better lighting or art.
omens.omen_zh: 通过更好的灯光或艺术品来升级你的环境。
omens.detail_en: Beauty fuels productivity. Enhancing your surroundings today will directly impact your creative output tomorrow.
omens.detail_zh: 美感能驱动生产力。今日提升环境品质，将直接影响你明天的创作产出。

omens.omen_en: Announce a strategic partnership or collaboration.
omens.omen_zh: 宣布一项战略合作伙伴关系或协作计划。
omens.detail_en: Forming an alliance is a power move. Today is lucky for public declarations of shared goals and mutual support.
omens.detail_zh: 结盟是一项有力的策略。今日利于公开声明共同目标与相互支持，确立盟约。

omens.omen_en: Sign a Letter of Intent for a future acquisition or deal.
omens.omen_zh: 为未来的收购或交易签署一份意向书。
omens.detail_en: Setting a formal path for union is favored. Today is for aligning 'intent' before the final contract is written.
omens.detail_zh: 为联合设定正式路径受吉星庇佑。今日宜在正式合同签署前，先达成‘意向’上的对齐。

omens.omen_en: Send a thank-you note to someone who helped you build.
omens.omen_zh: 给曾经帮助你创业或建设的人发一封感谢信。
omens.detail_en: Anciently a ceremony to thank the earth after building. Today, acknowledging your support system ensures future luck.
omens.detail_zh: 古代指工程完工后祭谢土地。今日通过感恩你的支持系统，能为未来积攒好运。

omens.omen_en: Review a completed project and acknowledge what you learned.
omens.omen_zh: 回顾一个已完成的项目，并确认你从中收到的启发。
omens.detail_en: Gratitude closes the loop and invites new projects. Use today to honor the 'ground' that hosted your recent success.
omens.detail_zh: 感恩能完成闭环并引来新项目。今日宜向促成你近期成功的‘基石’致敬。

omens.omen_en: Step into a leadership role or start your first day at a new job.
omens.omen_zh: 今日宜走马上任，或开启新职位的首日工作。
omens.detail_en: Taking office is about assuming authority. Today is auspicious for setting the tone of your leadership and making a strong first impression.
omens.detail_zh: 赴任关乎确立权威。今日最宜奠定你的领导基调，并给团队留下深刻的第一印象。

omens.omen_en: Accept a new set of responsibilities with a formal plan.
omens.omen_zh: 带着正式计划去接手一组全新的职责。
omens.detail_en: Responsibility is the precursor to growth. Today is lucky for taking the reins of a project and steering it toward your vision.
omens.detail_zh: 责任是成长的先导。今日利于接管项目主导权，并按照你的愿景指引航向。

omens.omen_en: Finalize the mission statement or core values of your startup.
omens.omen_zh: 敲定你初创公司的使命宣言或核心价值观。
omens.detail_en: Laying the foundation is about defining the 'why'. Today is lucky for setting the unshakeable principles that will support your future empire.
omens.detail_zh: 起基关乎定义‘初衷’。今日利于确立那些不可动摇的原则，支撑起你未来的事业版图。

omens.omen_en: Draft the initial architecture for a new app or system.
omens.omen_zh: 为一个新应用或系统起草最初的底层架构。
omens.detail_en: Every great structure starts underground. Use today to focus on the invisible logic that makes your visible work possible.
omens.detail_zh: 万丈高楼起于地下。今日宜专注于那些不可见的底层逻辑，它们是后续开发的基础。

omens.omen_en: Clean up your digital archives and move them to a better storage.
omens.omen_zh: 清理你的数字档案，并将其迁移到更好的存储介质中。
omens.detail_en: Moving a resting place is about optimizing the environment for the past. Today is lucky for re-organizing old assets to protect them for the future.
omens.detail_zh: 迁坟意在优化先人的环境。今日利于重整旧资产，通过更有序的存储方式为未来做好保护。

omens.omen_en: Update the documentation for a legacy project.
omens.omen_zh: 为某个遗留项目更新其技术文档。
omens.detail_en: Respecting what came before prevents future confusion. Today, clarifying the history of your work ensures it remains useful as you move on.
omens.detail_zh: 尊重过往方能避免未来的混乱。今日理清工作史，能确保这些成果在你离任后依然发挥作用。

omens.omen_en: Set up an automated emergency fund or savings vault.
omens.omen_zh: 设置一个自动化的紧急基金或储蓄金库。
omens.detail_en: Building a granary is about securing your surplus. Today is favored for creating systems that hold and protect your resources.
omens.detail_zh: 造仓关乎保障余粮。今日最利于建立那些能够留存并保护你资源的系统。

omens.omen_en: Invest in a high-capacity backup drive or cloud storage plan.
omens.omen_zh: 投资一个大容量备份硬盘或云存储计划。
omens.detail_en: Storage is the modern granary. Today is lucky for increasing your capacity to hold data, knowledge, or capital.
omens.detail_zh: 存储是现代的粮仓。今日利于扩充你承载数据、知识或资本的容量。

omens.omen_en: Create a space or community for shared values and inspiration.
omens.omen_zh: 为一个共同的价值观或灵感源泉创建一个空间/社区。
omens.detail_en: Building a temple is about creating a home for the spirit. Today is lucky for projects that unite people around a higher purpose.
omens.detail_zh: 造庙意在为精神安家。今日利于那些能将人们聚集在更高使命之下的项目。

omens.omen_en: Define the 'guiding principles' of your creative community.
omens.omen_zh: 为你所在的创意社区定义‘指导原则’。
omens.detail_en: Structure supports belief. Today is auspicious for establishing the rituals and rules that foster long-term collective growth.
omens.detail_zh: 结构支撑信仰。今日利于建立那些能促进集体长期增长的仪式与规则。

omens.omen_en: Facilitate a connection between two people in your network.
omens.omen_zh: 在你的社交圈中促成两个人的资源对接。
omens.detail_en: A bridge overcomes a gap. Today, being the 'connector' who helps others reach their goals will build your own social capital.
omens.detail_zh: 造桥意在跨越鸿沟。今日通过引荐资源帮助他人，将极大地积累你个人的社交资本。

omens.omen_en: Integrate two separate apps or systems via an API.
omens.omen_zh: 通过 API 将两个独立的应用或系统进行打通。
omens.detail_en: Connecting flows creates efficiency. Today is lucky for engineering pathways that allow data and value to travel faster.
omens.detail_zh: 连通流向能创造效率。今日利于设计技术路径，让数据和价值流转得更顺畅。

omens.omen_en: Optimize the environment for your creative 'assets'.
omens.omen_zh: 为你手头的创意‘资产’优化其生存与产出环境。
omens.detail_en: Providing a home for livestock ensures their productivity. Today, organize your tools so they are ready for action whenever you are.
omens.detail_zh: 为牲畜造圈意在保障产出。今日宜整理你的生产工具，确保它们随时处于待命状态。

omens.omen_en: Streamline the management of your small investments.
omens.omen_zh: 精简并优化你那些小额投资的管理流程。
omens.detail_en: Careful housing prevents loss. Today is auspicious for checking in on the 'small things' that aggregate into your total wealth.
omens.detail_zh: 妥善安顿方能防范流失。今日利于视察那些积少成多的资产项，确保其稳健增长。

omens.omen_en: Start building the platform that will carry your ideas to market.
omens.omen_zh: 开始搭建那个能将你的创意推向市场的平台。
omens.detail_en: A ship is a vessel for long journeys. Today is favored for starting the development of products that cross boundaries and reach new audiences.
omens.detail_zh: 船是远航的载体。今日最宜启动那些能够跨越边界、触达新受众的产品开发工作。

omens.omen_en: Invest in a new computer or tech gear for your career.
omens.omen_zh: 为你的职业生涯投资一台新电脑或科技装备。
omens.detail_en: A superior vessel handles rougher seas. Today is lucky for upgrading the hardware you rely on for your daily 'voyage'.
omens.detail_zh: 工欲善其事，必先利其器。今日利于升级那些支撑你每日‘航行’的核心硬件设备。

omens.omen_en: Automate a tedious part of your creative process.
omens.omen_zh: 将你创作过程中一个乏味的环节自动化。
omens.detail_en: Making tools for transport increases personal velocity. Today, building a script or macro is like adding wheels to your project.
omens.detail_zh: 制造车辆零件能提升个人速度。今日编写一段脚本或宏，就像是给你的项目装上了轮子。

omens.omen_en: Refine the most repetitive steps of your daily routine.
omens.omen_zh: 提炼并优化你日常流程中那些重复性最高的操作。
omens.detail_en: Efficiency is the engine of success. Today is lucky for 'machining' a smoother way to handle your high-frequency tasks.
omens.detail_zh: 效率是成功的引擎。今日利于针对高频任务，磨练出一套更顺滑的处理方式。

omens.omen_en: Find the single 'pressure point' that is blocking your project.
omens.omen_zh: 找出阻碍你项目进展的那一个‘痛点’。
omens.detail_en: Acupuncture is about precision release. Today, identifying the one small bottleneck and fixing it will restore the flow of your entire system.
omens.detail_zh: 针灸意在精准释放。今日找出那个关键的‘瓶颈’并予以解决，将使你的整个系统恢复活力。

omens.omen_en: Schedule a session with a specialist to fix a recurring pain.
omens.omen_zh: 预约一位专家，去解决那个反复出现的痛点问题。
omens.detail_en: Direct intervention is favored today. Don't mask the symptom; use today to apply a precise remedy to a long-standing issue.
omens.detail_zh: 今日利于直接干预。不要掩盖症状，而要针对顽疾应用最精准的补救措施。

omens.omen_en: Standardize your onboarding process for new clients or users.
omens.omen_zh: 为新客户或用户标准化你的入职流程。
omens.detail_en: Paving a road makes the journey smooth for others. Today is auspicious for creating clear pathways that reduce friction for your audience.
omens.detail_zh: 铺路意在为他人提供坦途。今日利于建立清晰的指引流程，以此降低受众进入你领域的门槛。

omens.omen_en: Write a 'How-To' guide or documentation for your team.
omens.omen_zh: 为你的团队编写一份操作指南或技术文档。
omens.detail_en: Success is easier when the path is marked. Today, documenting your process ensures that the momentum continues even when you aren't there.
omens.detail_zh: 路径明确，成功更易。今日记录你的操作流程，能确保即便你不在场，事业也能顺畅运行。

omens.omen_en: Conduct a deep background check or research on a potential partner.
omens.omen_zh: 对潜在的合作伙伴进行一次深度的背景调查或调研。
omens.detail_en: Anciently about verifying identities before marriage. Modernly, it is a lucky day for due diligence to ensure values are truly aligned.
omens.detail_zh: 古代指婚前询问姓名资历。在现代，这是进行尽职调查、确保双方价值观真正契合的吉日。

omens.omen_en: Register a new brand name or verify domain availability.
omens.omen_zh: 注册一个新的品牌名称，或验证域名的可用性。
omens.detail_en: A name carries destiny. Today is favored for claiming a title or identity that perfectly encapsulates your vision.
omens.detail_zh: 名字承载天命。今日利于锁定那个能完美概括你愿景的头衔或身份标识。

omens.omen_en: Shed an old professional title and embrace your new role.
omens.omen_zh: 卸下旧的职业头衔，全身心拥抱你的新角色。
omens.detail_en: Removing mourning garments marks the end of a restriction. Today, formally step out of the 'shadow' of your past work and into your new light.
omens.detail_zh: 除服标志着限制期的终结。今日宜正式走出过去工作的‘阴影’，步入全新的高光时刻。

omens.omen_en: Update your social media handles to reflect who you are now.
omens.omen_zh: 更新你的社交媒体账号信息，反映你现在的真实状态。
omens.detail_en: Changing your outward 'uniform' signals evolution. Use today to tell the world that a cycle has ended and a new one has begun.
omens.detail_zh: 改变外在的‘制服’预示着进化。今日宜向外界宣告一个旧周期的结束与新周期的开启。

omens.omen_en: Run a security scan and delete malware or tracking cookies.
omens.omen_zh: 进行一次安全扫描，删除恶意软件或追踪插件。
omens.detail_en: Pest control prevents invisible damage. Today is auspicious for a 'digital deep clean' to ensure your systems remain fast and private.
omens.detail_zh: 除虫意在防范隐形损害。今日利于‘数字大扫除’，确保系统运行飞快且隐私无忧。

omens.omen_en: Identify and stop a small, repetitive 'drain' on your focus.
omens.omen_zh: 识别并切断一个细小但反复出现的‘专注力黑洞’。
omens.detail_en: Small pests destroy the harvest. Today, eliminate one minor but persistent distraction to save your creative energy.
omens.detail_zh: 微小的害虫也会毁掉收成。今日宜铲除那个微小但顽固的干扰源，夺回你的创作能量。

omens.omen_en: Outsource a task that is below your current skill level.
omens.omen_zh: 将一项低于你目前专业水平的任务外包出去。
omens.detail_en: Hiring help is about leveraging your time. Today is lucky for finding a Virtual Assistant or freelancer to handle the boilerplate.
omens.detail_zh: 雇庸意在杠杆化你的时间。今日利于寻找虚拟助手或自由职业者来处理那些琐碎的常规工作。

omens.omen_en: Hire a specialist to solve a problem that has stalled you.
omens.omen_zh: 聘请一位专家来解决那个让你停滞不前的难题。
omens.detail_en: Buying expertise is the fastest way to grow. Today, investing in professional labor will yield a 10x return on your speed.
omens.detail_zh: 购买专业经验是增长的最快路径。今日在专业人力上的投入，将为你带来十倍的速度回报。

omens.omen_en: Refine the most important sentence of your project's copy.
omens.omen_zh: 精雕细琢你项目文案中最关键的那一句话。
omens.detail_en: Carving requires patience and precision. Today is favored for 'chiseling' away the fluff until only the powerful essence remains.
omens.detail_zh: 雕刻需要耐心与精准。今日利于‘凿掉’那些赘述，直到只剩下最核心、最有力量的精华。

omens.omen_en: Add the final aesthetic 'polish' to your design or product.
omens.omen_zh: 为你的设计或产品添加最后的视觉‘磨光’。
omens.detail_en: Detailing creates value. Today is lucky for those tiny adjustments that make a product feel premium and intentional.
omens.detail_zh: 细节创造价值。今日利于进行那些微小的调整，让产品散发出某种高级感与匠心。

omens.omen_en: Stick to your existing schedule; do not start anything new.
omens.omen_zh: 坚持现有的日程安排；今日不宜开启任何新计划。
omens.detail_en: When only routine is favored, deviation leads to chaos. Use today to master your current tasks without adding to your plate.
omens.detail_zh: 当仅利于常规时，偏离轨迹会导致混乱。今日宜深耕手头工作，不要给自己增加额外负担。

omens.omen_en: Decline all new invites and focus purely on maintenance.
omens.omen_zh: 拒绝所有新的邀约，纯粹专注于日常维护工作。
omens.detail_en: The energy today is for preservation, not expansion. Say 'no' to new opportunities so you can properly protect what you've already built.
omens.detail_zh: 今日的能量利于守成而非扩张。对新机会说‘不’，是为了更好地保护你已打下的江山。

omens.omen_en: Do absolutely nothing and embrace the stillness.
omens.omen_zh: 什么都别做，全身心拥抱这份静止。
omens.detail_en: Sometimes the most productive action is inaction. Today, force yourself to stop and recharge completely.
omens.detail_zh: 有时最有效率的行动就是不行动。今日，强迫自己停下来，进行彻底的充电。

omens.omen_en: Avoid making any major decisions today.
omens.omen_zh: 今日避免做任何重大决定。
omens.detail_en: Clarity comes after the pause. Wait for the fog to lift before you commit to a new path.
omens.detail_zh: 清晰总在暂停之后浮现。待迷雾散去，再承诺新的道路。
